snippet.title: GANA FORCE PV1 / 加纳力量 宣传PV1
snippet.description:
STG New Game -  Gana Force
STEAM store: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4737320

– A nostalgic retro pixel art style reminiscent of the 1990s.

– Multiple selectable mechs with diverse performance mechanics!

– Rich environments: plant planets, ice planets, space battleships, Moai statues, cell-based levels, and more!

– The music is also retro 8-bit!


STG新作 加纳力量
STEAM商店：https://store.steampowered.com/app/4737320

– 带你回到1990 年代的怀旧复古像素风格。 

– 多种机体可选择，多样性能机制玩法！ 

– 丰富的场景，植物星球，冰星球，宇宙战舰，摩艾石像，细胞关卡等等！

– 音乐也是复古8bit风格的哦！！
